sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 110
85 Stat. 393 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Public Law 92-142, Oct. 15, 1971: the Nebraska National Forest, Niobrara division, "shall be known and designated as the Samuel R. McKelvie National Forest"

Davis, The National Forests of the United States (Encyclopedia of American Forest and Conservation History, App. I, 1983), Forest History Society PDF; compiled partly from an earlier edition of the Forest Service chronologic record, so secondary corroboration only

review.note: Public Law 92-142, Oct. 15, 1971, 85 Stat. 393, Nixon. The act is worded as a renaming of the Niobrara division of the Nebraska NF, which made it a separately named national forest. (Davis misprints the page as 383.)
